title: nepenthes mirabilis
intro: Nepenthes mirabilis, commonly known as the Cobra Pitcher Plant, is a carnivorous plant species belonging to the Nepenthes genus. It is known for its unique ability to capture and digest insects, which helps it to obtain essential nutrients. The plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, and is also used for its therapeutic actions such as wound healing and digestive issues. Bioactive constituents found in the plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
